verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only developer API building blocks: endpoints for option grants, fair market values and stakeholders, plus an FMV API for calculating exercise tax implications. These are primitives a developer could use to build employee views, not a documented employee portal showing grants, vesting progress, strike price, or outcome scenarios. One community report of an employee exercising options through Carta hints at employee-facing access, but it does not evidence the portal capabilities this story asks for.
